attractions.name: Edakkal Caves
attractions.description: Caves in the Ambukuthi hills known for ancient rock engravings, prehistoric carvings and symbols.
tips: The visit involves an uphill walk.
Wear broken-in walking shoes with good grip.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Jungle Treasures Ayurvedic Spice Garden
attractions.description: Recommended local spice garden for exploring Wayanad's spice-growing heritage.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Kuruva Island
attractions.description: A cluster of river islands in the Kabini River, known for dense greenery, bamboo groves and riverside ecosystems.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: Wildlife sanctuary offering forest safaris in the Muthanga range, with opportunities to spot elephants, deer, wild boars and birds.
tips: Carry safari confirmations and any required entry documents.
Maintain silence and follow forest department instructions.
Do not feed animals or use flash photography.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Puttu with Kadala Curry
local_dishes.description: Steamed rice flour and coconut cakes served with black chickpea curry.
local_dishes._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Appam with Vegetable Stew
local_dishes.description: Soft, lacy rice pancakes paired with a mildly spiced coconut milk-based vegetable stew.
local_dishes._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Kerala Sadya
local_dishes.description: Traditional vegetarian feast served on a banana leaf, featuring rice, avial, thoran, sambar, olan and payasam.
local_dishes._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Malabar Vegetable Biryani
local_dishes.description: Fragrant rice cooked with vegetables and regional spices.
local_dishes._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Pazham Pori
local_dishes.description: Kerala-style ripe banana fritters, popular as a tea-time snack.
local_dishes._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Apoorva_Wayanad_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Unniyappam
local_dishes.description: Small sweet fritters made with rice flour, banana, jaggery and coconut.
